meta.title: Skills Manager
meta.description: Load and safely manage local Agent Skills.

en.error.repo.capacity: Source tracking exceeds 16 MiB. Remove unneeded Trash records or legacy identities first. Active installation copies are kept.
en.error.repo.conflict: A skill with this name exists or installation failed. Local files were not overwritten.
en.error.repo.enableState: The copied skill was removed because its enabled state could not be saved. Restore disk write access and install again.
en.error.repo.installState: Skill files were preserved but source tracking could not be saved. Restore disk write access and reopen Repositories to verify files and recover the record.
en.error.repo.invalid: Invalid repository URL, path or contents. Check the input and repository size.
en.error.repo.modified: Local edits detected. Review and confirm replacement with a backup.
en.error.repo.network: Repository request failed. Check your connection or retry later. The previous catalog was kept.
en.error.repo.state: Repository state is corrupt or unreadable. Preserve the file and repair it before retrying.
en.error.repo.tooLarge: Repository archive exceeds 32 MiB. Choose a smaller repository; a subdirectory filter does not reduce the download size.
en.repo.catalog.empty: No matching skills were returned by ClawHub.
en.repo.catalog.installRefreshWarning: Installed and enabled, but the list could not refresh. Reopen Discover Skills; do not install again.
en.repo.catalog.loadError: Failed to load the ClawHub ranking. Check your connection and retry.
en.repo.catalog.reassociate: Choose destination and reinstall to reassociate
en.repo.catalog.searchEmpty: No matching ClawHub skills were found.
en.repo.catalog.skillshEmpty: No matching skills.sh skills were found.
en.repo.catalog.uninstallRefreshWarning: Moved to trash, but the list could not refresh. Refresh the skill list or reopen Settings; do not uninstall again.
en.repo.catalog.unknownHint: Some legacy catalog installs have unknown locations. Find the skill and choose a destination to reinstall and reassociate.
en.repo.defaultBranch: Leave empty for the default branch
en.repo.destinationUnavailable: The original project is unregistered or unavailable. Re-register it in the sidebar and refresh to manage this copy.
en.repo.directoryHint: For example: skills. Leave empty to scan the repository.
en.repo.empty: No repositories yet. Add a public GitHub repository to get started.
en.repo.footer: Refresh checks repositories and skill updates without replacing local files. Historical backups are not cleaned automatically and use additional disk space.
en.repo.hint: Discover skills from subscribed GitHub repositories or community registries, and install them to user DSH skills or Shared Agent, or a registered project's .dsh/skills.
en.repo.installHint: Skills may include scripts. Read the instructions and trust the source before installing. Resources are copied; scripts are not executed.
en.repo.installLocationsHint: User directories offer DSH skills or Shared Agent; registered projects write only to .dsh/skills. The chooser shows actual paths. Missing directories are created after confirmation. Unsafe paths cannot be selected.
en.repo.installProgress: Reading and verifying skill files. Please waitu2026
en.repo.installSuccess: Installed and enabled. Invoke it from the slash menu.
en.repo.modified: Local edits detected. Replacement overwrites current files and keeps a complete backup for restoration.
en.repo.noSkills: No matching skills. Refresh the repository or adjust your filters.
en.repo.overwrite: Back up local edits and replace
en.repo.removeHint: This removes the subscription only. Installed skills are kept.
en.repo.rootDshHint: For DSH only. The path uses your current DSH_HOME.
en.repo.rootExternalHint: Other agents using this directory can read this skill too.
en.repo.sort.name: Name Au2013Z
en.repo.subsource.catalogNote: ClawHub download ranking xB7 Up to 100; sort only displayed items
en.repo.uninstallExternalWarning: Uninstalling this skill also affects other agents that use the selected directory.
en.repo.uninstallHint: Move only this repositoryu2019s tracked installed copy, including local edits, to Trash. You can restore it from Trash later.
en.repo.uninstallProgress: Moving the installed skill to Trash. Please waitu2026
en.repo.uninstallSuccess: Skill moved to Trash. You can restore it from Trash.
en.repo.updateProgress: Verifying, backing up and replacing files. Please waitu2026
